༄༅/ /bcu gcig zhal gyi cho ga'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa byin rlabs nyer 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcu gcig zhal gyi cho ga'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa byin rlabs nyer 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs/

rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus nas/ /snang mtha'i sras kyi tshul bzung pad dkar 'chang*/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po sbyan ras gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung bstan ji bzhin 'phags pa nyid bsgrubs pas/ /dngos su grub cing shing 'phel nags tshal du/ /mchog brnyes ḍā ki'i gtso mo grub pa'i dbang*/ /dpa' ldan dpa' mo'i zhabs la= /gnas lnga mkhyen pa zla ba gzhon nu dang*/ /dad stobs brtson pa phul byung ye shes bzang*/ /thugs rje chen pos rjes bzung pe nya pa/ /mkhas 'grub dam pa gsum la= /sems dpa' chen po zla ba rgyal mtshan dpal/ /grub pa'i go 'phang mngon gyur nyi phug pa/ /'phags nor bdun dang ldan pa chos kyi rje/ /rdo rje rgyal po gsum la= /'gro ba'i mgon po zhang ston dgra 'jigs zhabs/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems 'byongs rtse 'dul che/ /'khor lo bzhi dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' mchog /bde ba can pa'i zhabs la= /nyes ltung dri bral byang sems chu bzang ba/ /rtse gcig sgom bzlas la brtson dbang phyug par/ /lung rtogs yon tan mnga' bdag shes rab 'bum/ /rje btsun bla ma gsum la= /gzhan don lhur mdzad rgyal sras thogs med bzang*/ /sde snod kun gzigs rje btsun shes rab mtshan/ /brtse ba'i gter gyur tshul khrims dpal bzang bo/ /bshes gnyen dam pa gsum la= /phan bde'i rtsa lag yon tan rin po che/ /bslab gsum rnam dag sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /dam chos kun 'dzin rje btsun skyabs mchod dpal/ /zla med bla ma gsum la= /sku gsum mngon gyur blo bzang don yod grub/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rje/ /chos dbang grags pa'i sde la= /mngon rgyud man ngag kun gyi bang mdzod can/ /blo bzang chos kyis sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar brgya/ /'byed mkhas sems dpa' chen po paṇḍi ta/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/

/mdor na thugs rje chen po'i chos tshul gyi/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin brlabs nas/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i skal ba ldan pa shog / yang na/ ma lus rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse kun/ /gcig bsdus thugs rje'i gter chen zhes/ /'jig rten gsum mgon spyan ras gzigs/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /ind+ra bhu tis lung bstan bzhin/ /'phags pa bsgrubs pas go 'phang mchog /yongs brnyes dpal ldan dpal mo la/ /gsol ba= /gnas lnga mngon gyur zla ba gzhon/ /brtson 'grus phul byung ye shes bzang*/ /rig gnas kun gzigs pe nya ba/ /gsol ba= /byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan dpal/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug nyi phug pa/ /rje btsun rdo rje rgyal bo la/ /gsol ba= /bsdu bzhir mngon brtson zhang ston che/ /byang chub sems 'byong rtse 'dul ba/ /mkhas mchog bde ba can pa la/ /gsol ba= /gzhan don lhur mdzad chu bzang ba/ /brtson 'grus shugs ldan dbang phyug 'bar/ /zab don legs gzigs sher 'bum la/ /gsol ba= /rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang*/ /gzhung lugs kun mkhyen shes rab dpal/ /rnam dag tshul khrims mtshan can la/ /gsol ba= yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas che/ /rje btsun budha sa mu tra/ /mkhas grub skyabs mchog dpal ba la/ /gsol ba= grub pa'i dbang phyug dben sa pa/ /rje btsun sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba= /rdo rje 'dzin pa chos dbang grags/ /rgyal ba'i gdung tshob chos kyi rje/ /sems dpa' chen po paṇḍi tar/ /gsol 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na thugs rje chen po yi/ /chos tshul ji bzhin 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol btab byin brlabs mthus/ /skye kun dam pa'i bshes gnyen dang*/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis rjes bzung nas/

/rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog / smon lam ni/ de ltar zab gsal gnyis med rnal 'byor gyis/ /thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /mchod bstod bzlas pa sogs la rab 'bad pa'i/ /rnam dkar gyis mtshon dus gsum dge ba yis/ /bdag sogs mar gyur 'gro kun rtag tu yang*/ /mo khom skyon spangs dal 'byor rten rnyed nas/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bshes kyis rjes bzung ste/ /thun mong lam gyis rang rgyud 'dul bar shog /zab mo'i lam gyi snod du gyur ba na/ /bcom ldan thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /legs par zhugs nas dbang gis rgyud smin cing*/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin srung bar shog /rtse gcig mos pa'i shugs drag dad pa yis/ /tshogs kyi dam pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /lha yi 'khor lor dmigs nas tshogs bsags pas/ /bsod nams phung bo mngon par 'phel bar shog /bzlas brjod bstod dang bltos min bsam gtan gyis/ /tha mal snang zhing zhen pa'i dri ma kun/ ma lus drungs nas phyung ste mtshan bcas dang*/ /mtshan med rnal 'byor goms pa mthar phyin shog / khyad par gzungs sngags rgyal bo bzlas pa'i mes/ /thog med nas bsags sdig sgrib bud shing tshogs/ /gtan tu sreg pa'i tshul gyis rab sbyangs nas/ / rab 'byams las kun 'grub pa'i mthu thob shog /'chi ba'i tshe yang gnad gcod mi 'byung zhing*/ /bcom ldan 'od dpag med nyid 'khor bcas kyis/ / yongs bskor bde ba can du myur shog ces/ /dbyugs dbyung zhing der 'khrid nas lung bstan shog /dag pa'i zhing du skyes nas snying rje yis/ /ma dag 'jig rten khams kyi sems can kun/ /skal ba ji bzhin chos kyis smin byas te/ /bla med byang chub mchog la 'god par shog / shis brjod ni/ /rab yangs lha yi lam kun gang ba yi/ /bcom ldan thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs ni/ /me tog char 'beb bgegs 'joms 'phrin las kyis/ /khyed la phan bde'i dpal gnas mdzad pa 'di/

/shes par gyis la spro ba skyed cig dang*/ /shis brjod spel legs bdag gis bsgrags par bya/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i phung bo nyid/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang por phyag 'tshal nas/ /gang des rjes bzung gyur dbang dpal mo dang*/ /zla gzhon ye shes bzang dang pe nya pa/ /zla ba rgyal mtshan nyi phug pa la sogs/ /lam 'di'i dngos brgyud bla ma dam pa la/ / legs tshogs gang zhig mchis pa'i dpal des ni/ /khyed kyi mi shis kun sel dge legs tshogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i bkra shog /bcom ldan brtse ba'i gter gyur spyan ras gzigs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rigs lnga'i 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /legs tshogs= khyed kyi= /yar ngo'i= /thub pa'i legs par bshad pa'i phul byung ba/ /padma'i rigs gyur bya ba'i rgyud kun gyi/ /gtso bo spyan stong ldan pa'i rgyud rgyal la/ / legs tshogs= khyed kyi= /yar ngo'i= ma lus zhing na lam 'dir thos sogs kyis/ /brtson pas 'jug cing rtse gcig sgrub pa dang*/ /cha shas yan chad 'dzin pa thams cad la/ /legs tshogs= khyed kyi= /yar ngo'i= /sna tshogs rin chen las grub ye shes kyi/ /rang bzhin dbang bo'i gzhu ltar rab bkra ba/ /'od kyis phyogs kun 'gengs pa'i pho brang cher/ /legs tshogs= khyed kyi= /yar ngo'i= /yang na legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ /zhes sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ / ces 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal kyi dbang dang smyung gnas kyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol 'debs dang*/ cho ga'i smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa byin brlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba 'di ni/ /rnam dpyod phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas brtan wa kind+ra sa mu tras bskul ba ltar/ /shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis bgyis pa ste/ phyi ma dad stobs ldan ma'i sbis mgu'i sngags 'chang 'phags pa skyabs zhes bgyi bas tshe rabs kun tu thugs rje chen pos rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel mtshon phyir rang nyid kyis bris nas par du sgrubs pa'o//
// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bcu gcig zhal gyi cho ga'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 302-- PAGE 303-- PAGE 299-
